description: This Java class provides utility methods for stream processing, including a left fold collector and a specialized collector for merging maps with list values.

classes.name: StreamUtil
classes.description: A final utility class offering static methods for stream operations in Java.

methods.name: foldLeft
methods.description: Creates a collector that performs a left fold operation over a stream with an initial value and a combining function.

methods.name: mergeMapsOfLists
methods.description: Creates a collector that merges multiple maps with list values into a single map, concatenating lists for duplicate keys.
